rows.grounds: ablative compound expressing cause or means; kṣetra (field/sacred site) + ārohaṇa (ascending)
present indicative stating the result of the action

items.question: What abundant prosperity is gained through ascending the sacred field?
premises: Ascending the sacred field is an efficacious act.
The goddess is invoked as the addressee.
This act results in obtaining abundant prosperity.
items.inference: Ascending the sacred field grants the practitioner abundant prosperity.
uncertainties: Whether kṣetra refers to a specific pilgrimage site or a general sacred domain is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: O goddess, by ascending the sacred field one obtains abundant prosperity.
